plan.summary: BRO-5420 (a): re-credit 19 critic names cut at an apostrophe or Mc particle (Holly O' / Joe Mc / Caroline Mc / Neil Mc) to the full name. Three are live today (Midsummer Regent's Park 2026, Fool for Love 2015, Misery 2015); the rest are excluded duplicates or wrong-production rows corrected for consistency.
